Here is a list of all the Summer 2015 anime.

For my choices, my favourite so far is Overlord which despite its slow pace, is very amusing and just plain enjoyable to watch. Even though OP main characters are usually criticised, the MC in Overlord is great how he can deal with anything without putting in even the slightest bit of effort compared to the usual OP Main Characters which struggle a bit but always find a way.

God Eater disappointed me the most, even though I knew it wouldn't be anything amazing, halfway in and the series is starting to get boring for reasons ranging from the plain characters to the repetitive episodes and I'm half tempted to just drop it at this point.
[SS][Discussion] Out of all the Summer 2015 anime so far, which is your most/least favourite, which disappointing you the most and/or which was surprisingly good?

Favorite: Rokka No Yuusha

HMs: Overlord & Gangsta

Biggest Disappointment: God Eater for sure

Surprise pick up: Shimoneta

It's been an interesting season up to this point, only dropped God Eater so far, so overall pretty solid.

Gangsta is surprisingly interesting, and Overlord has also been a nice surprise. I'm a bit bummed that the music for Gatchaman C:I isn't quite as good as it was in the first season. GATE amuses me more than it probably should.

Current favorite: Shimoneta. It is literally doing everything right when it comes to being flat-out entertaining.

Least favorite: Gangsta. It just doesn't hold my attention - I dunno, it just spends too long in a bit of the moody stuff without enough bang for interest.

Disappointment: Charlotte. It's... god damnit, I really want to like it more than I do, but it keeps screwing up so much stupid shit. Sloppy storyboarding, sloppy characterization... even the latest episode, which had a lot going for it, fundamentally fucks up on a lot of stuff that can't be overlooked. It's not bad, just nowhere near as good as it should've been (hence, disappointment).

Surprisingly good: Shimoneta. Seriously, I don't think anyone saw this one coming; it's like how Gekkan Shoujo was last summer - a relatively unhyped show that blows the entire season out of the water with its comedy and production quality.

/v/Wagnaria (Working!!!) is the best this season, I'm really surprised a comedy show managed to stay good into season 3.

Monster Musume no Iru Nichijou Is surprisingly good. It knows its a Harem Ecchi show, but it decided to the best Harem Echhi show. You can tell the love and care put into the characters, as opposed to a lot of Ecchi where they just think boobs will get them viewers. It's refreshing to see them work for those views while also showing boobs.

Most favorite: Gakkou Gurashi!. It's by far my favorite Slice of Life show <3

Least favorite: Not counting shows I've dropped, I'd have to say it's a tie between Classroom☆Crisis, God Eater, and Ranpo Kitan. The first two are too boring, and Ranpo Kitan is just too weird.

Most disappointing: Can I count shows I've already dropped? If so, Chaos Dragon by far. If not, I had high expectations for God Eater due to ufotable, but it's been very boring so far.

Most surprising: I did not expect Shimoneta to be anywhere near as good or funny as it is.

My favorite Summer anime so far is MonMusu. I loved how it's a faithful adaptation of the manga with a few changes here and there. Monster girls = Win

My least favorite anime is Kangoku Gakuen. Censorship of fanservice done wrong here for me. I loved the way MonMusu's production team handled the censorship of the borderline-H scenes from the manga, doing it in a way which leaves a mark on the imagination.

Jitsu wa Watashi wa had disappointed me the most this season. The character designs, along with speeding up certain parts of the story (ex. Mikan learning about her glasses earlier than back in the manga). Kuromine looks like a guy on drugs, while Youko looks like she should be in a shoujo anime. The story in the manga was great, it had decent romantic development and character development compared to most mainstream manga, and it had good pacing. This anime adaptation is a big let down after such a good source material.

Shimoneta was the biggest surprise of this season. Watching this anime I got strong Seitokai Yakuindomo vibes, with a female character twisting anything into something perverted and spreading sexual awareness in a world where censorship is king. Then the fourth episode came up and that was when things got... interesting. I started to see how bleak this whole world in this anime is. Sure it had its funny, raunchy moments but when a certain character started going batshit pervy cause of how little her knowledge is about love, it made me think man, this sh*t's messed up. I also loved watching anime discussions of this series explode around the net after the infamous episode 4.

Current favorite: Non Non Biyori. It's something to look forward to every week. Relaxing, adorable, what's not to love.

Least favorite: Charlotte. It seems like the main story is finally picking up, after wasting a few episodes "monster of the week" style.

Disappointment: GATE. Don't get me wrong, I fucking love GATE as it is, but deep down inside, I wanted an action show. There needs to be a mindless violence Hollywood summer blockbuster with the same premise as GATE.

Surprisingly good: Shimoneta. Do I have to say more?
